reason: NONE. The first thing I noticed was the QR code and "Every batch lab-tested", which is the only part that gets my attention, but I already take magnesium at night at home and have a drawer of half-used bottles, so a pocket sachet solves a problem I don't have.
objection: I take magnesium at night at home, so why would I pay $29.99 for a sachet to carry around? Most supplements are marketing, and a lab report on the batch doesn't prove it will do anything for my sleep or stress.
would_change_my_mind: Real proof it works, like a clinical study or a lot of honest reviews from moms like me, plus a lower price per month than what I pay now, or a small trial pack so I don't add another half-used box to the drawer.
